Its red heading appears to read `Der .10. himel Cristalle glich` (tenth heaven, like crystal). The drawing is visibly wave-like within a bounded circular field; it is not a blue lobed border.

overall_assessment.answer_to_narrow_question: Yes. The upper 88v field is a wavy tenth heaven whose adjacent text explicitly invokes moisture, cold, and water's nature; the separate eleventh-heaven text explicitly denies literal burning despite fiery designation and flame-like red strokes.
limits: This is one witness and one fixed three-page segment; it is not evidence that any Voynich drawing has the same identity or meaning.
The upper strokes are yellow/gray rather than blue and fill a circle; the inspected pages show no four detached feather-like appendages or matching whole-panel composition.
The words are short visual readings, not a critical-edition transcription or a broader translation of the cosmology.
Do not infer a modern physical model, actual water substance, or a universal color/shape convention from this comparison.
